# Draft:Battle of La Trinidad (1983)

The Battle of La Trinidad (1983) was an armed engagement during the Contra War involving Contra forces and the Sandinista government near La Trinidad in northern Nicaragua.
Background
La Trinidad was located along a transportation corridor that was frequently contested during the early stages of the war.
Battle
Fighting occurred in and around the town as Contra forces challenged government positions.
Aftermath
Government forces retained control of La Trinidad following the engagement.
